title: Gham ye barpa hai aaj asghar
body:
Gham ye barpa hai aaj asghar ka
qaali jhoola hai aaj asghar ka
Teer zaalim se aah maidaa'n me
halq chid'ta hai aaj asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheh mahine ke baad bano se
saat chut'ta hai aaj asghar ka
Koi jaake kahe ye maadar se
qoon behta hai aaj asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye zahra ka laal leke lahu
Muh pe malta hai aaj asghar ka
Fouje dushman bhi khoon roti hai
haal aisa hai aaj asghar ka
